import numpy as np

def target(p,t,start,d):
    # Two linear stages; an intermediate pose controls the direction of descent.
    t1,t2,h1,k1,a1,h2,k2,a2,sh,el,roll,gain=p
    v1=np.zeros(19);v2=np.zeros(19)
    for v,h,k,a in [(v1,h1,k1,a1),(v2,h2,k2,a2)]:
        v[[2,7]]=h;v[[3,8]]=k;v[[4,9]]=a
        v[[11,15]]=sh;v[[14,18]]=el;v[1]=roll;v[6]=-roll
    tt=t+1
    if tt<=t1:
        u=tt/t1;v=start*(1-u)+v1*u
    elif tt<t1+t2:
        u=(tt-t1)/t2;v=v1*(1-u)+v2*u
    else:v=v2
    # Hip feedback only after seat contact; pitch from torso orientation.
    if tt>t1+t2 and gain:
        pitch=np.arctan2(d.xmat[12,2],d.xmat[12,8])
        v[[2,7]]+=gain*pitch
    return v
